vulnerabilities.description: Hardcoded demo password 'demo1234' visible in seed script. If seed is run in production, accounts with known credentials are created. This poses a critical authentication bypass risk.
Admin user created with known credentials (admin@demo.com / demo1234) during seeding. Direct threat to production systems if not properly scoped to dev-only environments.
RouteContext type is used but not defined/imported. Type safety issue could lead to runtime errors and unexpected behavior in route handling.
RouteContext type undefined. Potential type safety gap in dynamic route parameter handling.
RouteContext type undefined. Same type safety issue affects route parameter parsing.
Period validation is minimal - accepts any string format. While not directly exploitable (not used in queries), this should have format validation (e.g., YYYY-MM).
No sanitization of memory keys that could theoretically be used in file paths. Minimal risk but should validate keys against path traversal patterns.

recommendations: CRITICAL: Remove hardcoded credentials from seed.ts. Use environment variables or a separate dev-only seed config. Implement checks to prevent seed from running in production.
FIX: Import and properly define RouteContext type in all dynamic API routes ([id]/route.ts files). This ensures type safety.
ADD: Validate period format in payroll route with regex (^\d{4}-\d{2}$) to enforce YYYY-MM format.
ADD: Implement seed.ts guard: wrap all seeding code in `if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production')` or use a separate .dev.seed.ts file.
GOOD: Codebase properly uses Prisma ORM (parameterized queries) - SQL injection risk is low across API routes.
GOOD: All endpoints verify authentication via `getServerSession()` and enforce tenant isolation.
GOOD: Role-based authorization is correctly implemented (ADMIN/HR checks in payroll, leave, dept endpoints).
GOOD: Uses bcrypt for password hashing, JWT sessions are properly configured.
ADD: Add input validation on date fields (attendance, leaves) to ensure valid ISO date formats.
ADD: Implement rate limiting on auth and API endpoints to prevent brute force attacks.
